title: Hermite coefficient as an inner product
statement: For every natural number $n$, every function $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ that belongs to $L^2$ for standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$, and every multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$, the inner product of the $L^2$ class of $f$ with the normalized multivariate Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$ equals $\int f(x)H_\alpha(x)\,d\gamma_n(x)$, where $H_\alpha$ denotes that Hermite function.
hypotheses_covered: Function $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ belongs to Gaussian $L^2$
